title: Ashmita Shares Journey After Injury, Maiden World Tour Title
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita discusses her challenging comeback story, culminating in her first BWF World Tour title.
summary: Indian shuttler Ashmita opens up about her struggles with self-belief after an injury and losing sponsorship, and her eventual triumph in winning her maiden BWF World Tour title.

title: Indian Shuttlers Face Tricky Conditions at Worlds
indian_angle: This report details the performance of Indian players Lakshya Sen and Unnati Hooda, and a doubles pair, at the BWF World Championships.
summary: Indian shuttlers, including Lakshya Sen and Unnati Hooda, navigated challenging conditions at the BWF World Championships, with mixed results for the contingent.

title: Lakshya Sen, Treesa-Gayatri Advance at BWF Worlds
indian_angle: Indian star Lakshya Sen and the women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured wins to progress in the BWF World Championships.
summary: Lakshya Sen overcame early jitters to prevail over Collins Valentine Filimon of Austria in three games, while Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand also advanced to the second round of the BWF World Championships.

title: Ayush Shetty Upsets World Champion Shi Yu Qi at Worlds
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty delivered a sensational upset by defeating the defending world champion and world No. 1 Shi Yu Qi.
summary: In a thrilling BWF World Championships match, Ayush Shetty stunned defending champion Shi Yu Qi with a 21-14, 13-21, 21-19 victory, marking a significant upset.

title: PV Sindhu Dominates Opening Match at BWF Worlds
indian_angle: India's PV Sindhu began her BWF World Championships campaign with a strong win, aiming for a record sixth medal.
summary: PV Sindhu secured a commanding 21-7, 21-11 victory against Sophia Noble in her first match at the BWF World Championships, setting her sights on a historic sixth medal.

title: India Hosts BWF Worlds After 17 Years, Shetty Shines
indian_angle: India is hosting the BWF World Championships after 17 years, and the event started with a bang for home fans thanks to Ayush Shetty's upset.
summary: The BWF World Championships returned to New Delhi after a 17-year hiatus, with the opening day highlighted by a roaring home crowd and Ayush Shetty's stunning upset victory.
